title: Storage health
description: Every physical disk and storage pool in one place.

panels.title: Disks
panels.description: Physical disks on TrueNAS and Proxmox.

targets.expr: count(max by (disk, model) (label_join((label_replace(smartctl_device, "model", "$1", "model_name", "(.*)") or nvme_device_info) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device")))

panels.title: Failing
panels.description: Disks that failed SMART or report an NVMe critical warning.

targets.expr: count((max by (disk) (label_join((smartctl_device_smart_status or (nvme_critical_warning == bool 0)) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))) == 0 or (max by (disk) (label_join((smartctl_device_critical_warning or nvme_critical_warning) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Disks with bad sectors
panels.description: Disks with media errors, or reallocated, pending or uncorrectable sectors.

targets.expr: count((max by (disk) (label_join((smartctl_device_media_errors or nvme_media_errors_total) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))) > 0 or (max by (disk) (label_join((smartctl_device_attribute{attribute_name=~"Reallocated_Sector_Ct", attribute_value_type="raw"}) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))) > 0 or (max by (disk) (label_join((smartctl_device_attribute{attribute_name=~"Current_Pending_Sector", attribute_value_type="raw"}) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))) > 0 or (max by (disk) (label_join((smartctl_device_attribute{attribute_name=~"Offline_Uncorrectable|Reported_Uncorrect", attribute_value_type="raw"}) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: CRC errors
panels.description: Link errors between disk and controller, summed over all disks. They point at cables or backplanes, and matter when they rise.

targets.expr: sum(max by (disk) (label_join((smartctl_device_attribute{attribute_name=~"UDMA_CRC_Error_Count|CRC_Error_Count", attribute_value_type="raw"}) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))) or vector(0)

max(max by (disk) (label_join((smartctl_device_temperature{temperature_type="current"} or nvme_temperature_celsius) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device")))

max(max by (disk) (label_join((nvme_percentage_used_ratio or smartctl_device_percentage_used / 100 or (100 - smartctl_device_attribute{attribute_name=~"Wear_Leveling_Count|Media_Wearout_Indicator|Percent_Lifetime_Remain", attribute_value_type="value"}) / 100) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device")))
count(node_zfs_zpool_state{state="online"} == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Fullest storage
panels.description: Highest usage among the pools in Capacity.

targets.expr: max(1 - max by (pool) (label_replace(max by (zpool) (label_replace(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{instance="sandcrawler", fstype="zfs", mountpoint=~"/mnt/[^/.][^/]*"}, "zpool", "$1", "device", "(.*)")), "pool", "sandcrawler/$1", "zpool", "(.*)") or label_replace(max by (id) (pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"storage/.+"} - pve_disk_usage_bytes{id=~"storage/.+"}), "pool", "pve/$1", "id", "storage/[^/]+/(.*)") or label_replace(max by (thin_pool) (kube_customresource_lvm_thinpool_free_bytes), "pool", "k8s0/$1", "thin_pool", "(.*)")) / max by (pool) (label_replace(sum by (zpool) (label_replace(max by (device) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance="sandcrawler", fstype="zfs", mountpoint=~"/mnt/.+"} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{instance="sandcrawler", fstype="zfs", mountpoint=~"/mnt/.+"}), "zpool", "$1", "device", "([^/]+).*")) + max by (zpool) (label_replace(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{instance="sandcrawler", fstype="zfs", mountpoint=~"/mnt/[^/.][^/]*"}, "zpool", "$1", "device", "(.*)")), "pool", "sandcrawler/$1", "zpool", "(.*)") or label_replace(max by (id) (pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"storage/.+"}), "pool", "pve/$1", "id", "storage/[^/]+/(.*)") or label_replace(max by (thin_pool) (kube_customresource_lvm_thinpool_size_bytes), "pool", "k8s0/$1", "thin_pool", "(.*)")))

panels.title: All disks
panels.description: TrueNAS drives from smartctl_exporter and Proxmox NVMe drives from the textfile collector (refreshed every 15 minutes). Endurance comes from NVMe percentage used or the SATA SSD wear attribute. Written 24h and Busy come from node_exporter. A dash means the disk does not report that value.

targets.expr: max by (disk, model) (label_join((label_replace(smartctl_device, "model", "$1", "model_name", "(.*)") or nvme_device_info) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))

max by (disk, serial) (label_join((label_replace(smartctl_device, "serial", "$1", "serial_number", "(.*)") or nvme_device_info) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))

max by (disk) (label_join(((smartctl_device_rotation_rate > bool 0) or smartctl_device * 0 or nvme_device_info * 2) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))
max by (disk) (label_join((smartctl_device_capacity_bytes or nvme_physical_size_bytes) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))
max by (disk) (label_join((smartctl_device_smart_status or (nvme_critical_warning == bool 0)) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))
max by (disk) (label_join((smartctl_device_critical_warning or nvme_critical_warning) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))

max by (disk) (label_join((smartctl_device_temperature{temperature_type="current"} or nvme_temperature_celsius) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))
max by (disk) (label_join((smartctl_device_power_on_seconds or nvme_power_on_hours_total * 3600) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))

max by (disk) (label_join((nvme_percentage_used_ratio or smartctl_device_percentage_used / 100 or (100 - smartctl_device_attribute{attribute_name=~"Wear_Leveling_Count|Media_Wearout_Indicator|Percent_Lifetime_Remain", attribute_value_type="value"}) / 100) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))
max by (disk) (label_join((nvme_available_spare_ratio or smartctl_device_available_spare / 100) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))
max by (disk) (label_join((smartctl_device_media_errors or nvme_media_errors_total) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))

max by (disk) (label_join((smartctl_device_attribute{attribute_name=~"Reallocated_Sector_Ct", attribute_value_type="raw"}) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))

max by (disk) (label_join((smartctl_device_attribute{attribute_name=~"Current_Pending_Sector", attribute_value_type="raw"}) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))

max by (disk) (label_join((smartctl_device_attribute{attribute_name=~"Offline_Uncorrectable|Reported_Uncorrect", attribute_value_type="raw"}) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))

max by (disk) (label_join((smartctl_device_attribute{attribute_name=~"UDMA_CRC_Error_Count|CRC_Error_Count", attribute_value_type="raw"}) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))
max by (disk) (label_join((nvme_unsafe_shutdowns_total) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))

max by (disk) (label_join((increase(node_disk_written_bytes_total[1d]) and on (instance, device) (smartctl_device or nvme_device_info)) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))

max by (disk) (label_join((rate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total[5m]) and on (instance, device) (smartctl_device or nvme_device_info)) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))

panels.title: Storage used
panels.description: TrueNAS ZFS pools (estimated, see Storage pools), Proxmox storages and k8s0's OpenEBS thin pool, which holds every app volume.

targets.expr: 1 - max by (pool) (label_replace(max by (zpool) (label_replace(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{instance="sandcrawler", fstype="zfs", mountpoint=~"/mnt/[^/.][^/]*"}, "zpool", "$1", "device", "(.*)")), "pool", "sandcrawler/$1", "zpool", "(.*)") or label_replace(max by (id) (pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"storage/.+"} - pve_disk_usage_bytes{id=~"storage/.+"}), "pool", "pve/$1", "id", "storage/[^/]+/(.*)") or label_replace(max by (thin_pool) (kube_customresource_lvm_thinpool_free_bytes), "pool", "k8s0/$1", "thin_pool", "(.*)")) / max by (pool) (label_replace(sum by (zpool) (label_replace(max by (device) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance="sandcrawler", fstype="zfs", mountpoint=~"/mnt/.+"} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{instance="sandcrawler", fstype="zfs", mountpoint=~"/mnt/.+"}), "zpool", "$1", "device", "([^/]+).*")) + max by (zpool) (label_replace(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{instance="sandcrawler", fstype="zfs", mountpoint=~"/mnt/[^/.][^/]*"}, "zpool", "$1", "device", "(.*)")), "pool", "sandcrawler/$1", "zpool", "(.*)") or label_replace(max by (id) (pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"storage/.+"}), "pool", "pve/$1", "id", "storage/[^/]+/(.*)") or label_replace(max by (thin_pool) (kube_customresource_lvm_thinpool_size_bytes), "pool", "k8s0/$1", "thin_pool", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Storage pools
panels.description: The forecast extends the last 3 days' trend by a week. ZFS pool usage is an estimate from mounted datasets: snapshots and zvols are missing and clones count twice; TrueNAS's own pool alerts use the exact numbers. State is the ZFS pool state; boot-pool has no mount under /mnt, so it shows only its state.

targets.expr: max by (pool, state) (label_replace(node_zfs_zpool_state == 1, "pool", "sandcrawler/$1", "zpool", "(.*)"))

max by (pool) (label_replace(sum by (zpool) (label_replace(max by (device) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance="sandcrawler", fstype="zfs", mountpoint=~"/mnt/.+"} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{instance="sandcrawler", fstype="zfs", mountpoint=~"/mnt/.+"}), "zpool", "$1", "device", "([^/]+).*")) + max by (zpool) (label_replace(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{instance="sandcrawler", fstype="zfs", mountpoint=~"/mnt/[^/.][^/]*"}, "zpool", "$1", "device", "(.*)")), "pool", "sandcrawler/$1", "zpool", "(.*)") or label_replace(max by (id) (pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"storage/.+"}), "pool", "pve/$1", "id", "storage/[^/]+/(.*)") or label_replace(max by (thin_pool) (kube_customresource_lvm_thinpool_size_bytes), "pool", "k8s0/$1", "thin_pool", "(.*)"))

1 - max by (pool) (label_replace(max by (zpool) (label_replace(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{instance="sandcrawler", fstype="zfs", mountpoint=~"/mnt/[^/.][^/]*"}, "zpool", "$1", "device", "(.*)")), "pool", "sandcrawler/$1", "zpool", "(.*)") or label_replace(max by (id) (pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"storage/.+"} - pve_disk_usage_bytes{id=~"storage/.+"}), "pool", "pve/$1", "id", "storage/[^/]+/(.*)") or label_replace(max by (thin_pool) (kube_customresource_lvm_thinpool_free_bytes), "pool", "k8s0/$1", "thin_pool", "(.*)")) / max by (pool) (label_replace(sum by (zpool) (label_replace(max by (device) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance="sandcrawler", fstype="zfs", mountpoint=~"/mnt/.+"} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{instance="sandcrawler", fstype="zfs", mountpoint=~"/mnt/.+"}), "zpool", "$1", "device", "([^/]+).*")) + max by (zpool) (label_replace(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{instance="sandcrawler", fstype="zfs", mountpoint=~"/mnt/[^/.][^/]*"}, "zpool", "$1", "device", "(.*)")), "pool", "sandcrawler/$1", "zpool", "(.*)") or label_replace(max by (id) (pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"storage/.+"}), "pool", "pve/$1", "id", "storage/[^/]+/(.*)") or label_replace(max by (thin_pool) (kube_customresource_lvm_thinpool_size_bytes), "pool", "k8s0/$1", "thin_pool", "(.*)"))

max by (pool) (label_replace(max by (zpool) (label_replace(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{instance="sandcrawler", fstype="zfs", mountpoint=~"/mnt/[^/.][^/]*"}, "zpool", "$1", "device", "(.*)")), "pool", "sandcrawler/$1", "zpool", "(.*)") or label_replace(max by (id) (pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"storage/.+"} - pve_disk_usage_bytes{id=~"storage/.+"}), "pool", "pve/$1", "id", "storage/[^/]+/(.*)") or label_replace(max by (thin_pool) (kube_customresource_lvm_thinpool_free_bytes), "pool", "k8s0/$1", "thin_pool", "(.*)"))

max by (pool) (label_replace(clamp_min(predict_linear((max by (zpool) (label_replace(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{instance="sandcrawler", fstype="zfs", mountpoint=~"/mnt/[^/.][^/]*"}, "zpool", "$1", "device", "(.*)")))[3d:30m], 7 * 86400), 0), "pool", "sandcrawler/$1", "zpool", "(.*)") or label_replace(clamp_min(predict_linear((max by (id) (pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"storage/.+"} - pve_disk_usage_bytes{id=~"storage/.+"}))[3d:30m], 7 * 86400), 0), "pool", "pve/$1", "id", "storage/[^/]+/(.*)") or label_replace(clamp_min(predict_linear((max by (thin_pool) (kube_customresource_lvm_thinpool_free_bytes))[3d:30m], 7 * 86400), 0), "pool", "k8s0/$1", "thin_pool", "(.*)"))

max by (disk) (label_join((smartctl_device_temperature{temperature_type="current"} or nvme_temperature_celsius) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))

panels.title: Endurance used
panels.description: Rises slowly over months; a sudden jump means heavy writes.

targets.expr: max by (disk) (label_join((nvme_percentage_used_ratio or smartctl_device_percentage_used / 100 or (100 - smartctl_device_attribute{attribute_name=~"Wear_Leveling_Count|Media_Wearout_Indicator|Percent_Lifetime_Remain", attribute_value_type="value"}) / 100) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))

panels.title: Busy
panels.description: Share of time each disk had IO in flight.

targets.expr: max by (disk) (label_join((rate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total[$__rate_interval]) and on (instance, device) (smartctl_device or nvme_device_info)) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))

max by (disk) (label_join((rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total[$__rate_interval]) and on (instance, device) (smartctl_device or nvme_device_info)) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device"))

panels.title: New errors
panels.description: Increase of each error counter over the previous hour. Empty is good.

targets.expr: increase((max by (disk) (label_join((smartctl_device_media_errors or nvme_media_errors_total) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device")))[1h:5m]) > 0

increase((max by (disk) (label_join((smartctl_device_attribute{attribute_name=~"Reallocated_Sector_Ct", attribute_value_type="raw"}) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device")))[1h:5m]) > 0

increase((max by (disk) (label_join((smartctl_device_attribute{attribute_name=~"Current_Pending_Sector", attribute_value_type="raw"}) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device")))[1h:5m]) > 0

increase((max by (disk) (label_join((smartctl_device_attribute{attribute_name=~"Offline_Uncorrectable|Reported_Uncorrect", attribute_value_type="raw"}) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device")))[1h:5m]) > 0

increase((max by (disk) (label_join((smartctl_device_attribute{attribute_name=~"UDMA_CRC_Error_Count|CRC_Error_Count", attribute_value_type="raw"}) unless on (instance, device) smartctl_device{scsi_vendor="QEMU"}, "disk", "/", "instance", "device")))[1h:5m]) > 0
